test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 07 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The rural life can be __contrasted to__ that of urban life.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. contrasted with .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb **"contrast"** is typically followed by the preposition **"with"** when indicating a comparison between two things to highlight differences.
 
• The sentence compares rural life with urban life, so the correct preposition to use is **"with"**.
 
• None of the other prepositions like **"at," "off," or "in"** are appropriate in this context.

Correct sentence: *The rural life can be **contrasted with** that of urban life.*
